checks.chk_plan_dates: effective_to IS NULL OR effective_to >= effective_from
checks.chk_plan_mode: (pay_type='salary' AND fixed_salary IS NOT NULL AND fixed_salary >= 0 AND salary_period IS NOT NULL AND salary_period IN ('weekly','biweekly','monthly') AND commission_rate IS NULL) OR (pay_type='commission' AND fixed_salary IS NULL AND salary_period IS NULL AND commission_rate IS NOT NULL AND commission_rate BETWEEN 0 AND 100 AND commission_base IS NOT NULL AND commission_base='net_items' AND commission_trigger IS NOT NULL AND commission_trigger='payment')

checks.chk_var_price: sale_price >= 0 AND (cost_price IS NULL OR cost_price >= 0)

checks.chk_media_dimensions: (width_px IS NULL OR width_px > 0) AND (height_px IS NULL OR height_px > 0) AND (byte_size IS NULL OR byte_size > 0)

primary_product_id.generated: CASE WHEN is_primary = 1 THEN product_id ELSE NULL END

checks.chk_quota_size: max_bytes > 0 AND max_single_upload_bytes > 0 AND max_images_per_product BETWEEN 1 AND 5

checks.chk_stock_nonneg: on_hand >= 0 AND reserved >= 0 AND reserved <= on_hand

checks.chk_order_totals: subtotal >= 0 AND discount_total >= 0 AND tax_total >= 0 AND shipping_total >= 0 AND grand_total >= 0

checks.chk_oi_amount: quantity > 0 AND unit_price >= 0 AND line_discount >= 0 AND line_tax >= 0 AND line_total >= 0 AND (commission_rate_snapshot IS NULL OR commission_rate_snapshot BETWEEN 0 AND 100) AND (commission_plan_id IS NULL OR seller_employee_id IS NOT NULL)

checks.chk_res_qty: quantity > 0 AND fulfilled_quantity >= 0 AND released_quantity >= 0 AND fulfilled_quantity + released_quantity <= quantity

checks.chk_invoice_source: (weekly_account_id IS NOT NULL AND order_id IS NULL) OR (weekly_account_id IS NULL AND order_id IS NOT NULL)
checks.chk_invoice_amount: subtotal >= 0 AND discount_total >= 0 AND tax_total >= 0 AND shipping_total >= 0 AND grand_total >= 0

checks.chk_invoice_order_source: (direct_order_id IS NOT NULL AND direct_order_id = order_id AND weekly_account_id IS NULL) OR (direct_order_id IS NULL AND weekly_account_id IS NOT NULL)

checks.chk_ii_amount: quantity > 0 AND unit_price >= 0 AND discount_amount >= 0 AND tax_amount >= 0 AND line_total >= 0 AND (commission_rate_snapshot IS NULL OR commission_rate_snapshot BETWEEN 0 AND 100) AND (commission_plan_id IS NULL OR seller_employee_id IS NOT NULL)
checks.chk_invoice_item_source: (order_item_id IS NULL AND order_id IS NULL AND variant_id IS NULL) OR (order_item_id IS NOT NULL AND order_id IS NOT NULL AND variant_id IS NOT NULL)

checks.chk_private_document: version > 0 AND provider IN ('local','r2') AND status IN ('pending','ready','failed') AND (status <> 'ready' OR (object_key IS NOT NULL AND object_key_hash IS NOT NULL AND sha256 IS NOT NULL AND byte_size IS NOT NULL AND byte_size > 0))

checks.chk_payment_status: status IN ('pending','confirmed','failed','reversed') AND (status <> 'confirmed' OR paid_at IS NOT NULL)

checks.chk_return_restock_variant: restock = 0 OR variant_id IS NOT NULL

checks.chk_ref_kind: (refund_kind='return' AND sales_return_id IS NOT NULL AND invoice_id IS NOT NULL) OR (refund_kind='unused_credit' AND sales_return_id IS NULL AND invoice_id IS NULL)

checks.chk_ccm_event: (event_type='receipt' AND amount_delta>0 AND payment_allocation_id IS NULL AND refund_id IS NULL) OR (event_type='allocation' AND amount_delta<0 AND payment_allocation_id IS NOT NULL AND refund_id IS NULL) OR (event_type='unused_refund' AND amount_delta<0 AND payment_allocation_id IS NULL AND refund_id IS NOT NULL) OR (event_type='reversal' AND amount_delta<0 AND payment_allocation_id IS NULL AND refund_id IS NULL)

checks.chk_ce_sign: (entry_type='earn' AND amount >= 0) OR (entry_type='reversal' AND amount <= 0) OR (entry_type='adjustment')
checks.chk_commission_source: (entry_type='earn' AND payment_allocation_id IS NOT NULL AND refund_id IS NULL) OR (entry_type='reversal' AND (payment_allocation_id IS NOT NULL OR refund_id IS NOT NULL)) OR entry_type='adjustment'
